phase1_initial_proposals.technology_specification: Medium Altitude Long Endurance (MALE) Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance (ISR) Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) typically featuring a turboprop or piston engine, electro-optical/infrared (EO/IR) sensors, and satellite communication payloads optimized for persistent tactical and strategic missions.
phase1_initial_proposals.technology_reasoning: MALE ISR UAVs are the most common category of tactical and operational-level unmanned aerial systems in military service worldwide, offering endurance of 20+ hours at altitudes around 10,000-30,000 feet. Their configuration typically includes distinct modular subsystems such as propulsion, sensor suites, avionics, and datalinks which are separately sourced and integrated, making this specification the dominant industry-standard form.
